implementationAnswer.instrument: Article987's Motion to Set Aside Conviction and Dismiss Prosecution, Rule to Show Cause, and Order of Dismissal as one three-part statutory instrument. This is the set-aside/dismissal step, not an Article977/978 expungement motion or final record destruction.
implementationAnswer.actor: Defendant/mover, or actually retained attorney. Mover signs the unrepresented block when pro se. Judge controls the rule's hearing date/time and both judicial signatures and entry acts. DA supplies any response or consent; none is generated as fact by LegalEase.
implementationAnswer.destination: Clerk of the court that imposed the deferred sentence in the parish of conviction, in the existing criminal case. Preserve actual docket/division/charge/court, rather than manufacturing a new civil case or statewide mailing address.
implementationAnswer.trigger: Actual deferral under Article894(B) for the misdemeanor branch or Article893(E) for the felony branch, elapsed deferral and successful probation completion as the prescribed motion alleges. Record facts must support the selected branch; no automated legal finding from a dismissal label.
implementationAnswer.timingDeadline: Use actual deferral/completion evidence; Article987 prints no fixed outer filing deadline or sixty-day objection window. The rule sets the actual return/hearing date; do not import the expungement-stage Articles979/980 timeline. A contested-hearing referral does not suspend any court date.
components: Full prescribed motion, including DOCKET NUMBER, CHARGE, DATE OF ARREST, ARRESTING AGENCY, CITY/PARISH OF ARREST
Actual representation election and appropriate mover or attorney name/contact/signature block
Full Rule to Show Cause, keeping judicial settings/execution blank and PLEASE SERVE lines intact
Full unsigned Order of Dismissal with its prescribed operative text and service recipients; do not replace fixed statutory prose with empty findings or invented questionnaire text
Practical filing/service instructions and actual supporting deferral/completion records when requested or required by the case
implementationAnswer.feesWaiver: Preserve the adopted distinction: Article983 expungement charges and Article988 exemption are not automatically the cost/waiver treatment for this antecedent987 motion. No parish-specific price or operative local waiver form was established here. Ask the named sentencing-court clerk for that narrow input; do not label an unknown fee zero or promise that no fee relief can exist merely because987 prescribes none.
implementationAnswer.noticeService: The prescribed rule and order each identify District Attorney and attorney for Defendant and/or Defendant as service recipients. Preserve the prescribed contradictory-hearing prayer. A service request is not completed service; no unspecified delivery method or lead time is invented.
implementationAnswer.exactSelfHelpStop: Preserve existing stops for disputed deferral/completion, uncertainty about893/894basis, DA opposition or contested evidentiary hearing. The existence of a routine rule/hearing and a statute-provided pro-se block is not a new universal counsel mandate. Do not falsely certify that DA consent/hearing/order entry already happened.
